sn42.11:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Malatesu viharati Uruvelakappaṃ nāma Malatānaṃ nigamo || || 2
sn42.11:1.2: Atha kho Bhadragako gāmaṇi yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Bhadragako gāmaṇi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn42.11:1.3: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā dukkhassa samudayaṃ ca atthagamaṃ ca desetū ti || || Ahaṃ
sn42.11:1.4: ce te gāmaṇi atītam addhānam ārabbha dukkhassa samudayañca atthagamañca deseyyam
sn42.11:1.5: Evam ahosi atītam addhānanti || tatra te siyā kaṅkhā siyā vimati || ||
sn42.11:1.6: Ahaṃ ce te gāmaṇi anāgatam addhānam ārabbha dukkhassa samudayaṃ ca atthagamaṃ ca deseyyaṃ
sn42.11:1.7: Evaṃ bhavissati anāgatam addhānanti || tatrāpi te siyā kaṅkhā siyā vimati || ||
sn42.11:1.8: Api cāham gāmaṇi idheva nisinno ettheva te nisinnassa dukkhassa samudayañca atthagamañca desissāmi ||
sn42.11:1.9: taṃ suṇohi sādhukam manasi karohi bhāsissāmī ti || ||
sn42.11:1.10: Evam bhante ti kho Bhadragako gāmaṇi Bhagavato paccassosi || || 4
sn42.11:2.2: atthi te Uruvelakappe manussā yesaṃ te vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti || ||
sn42.11:2.3: Atthi me bhante Uruvelakappe manussā yesam me vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti || || 5
sn42.11:2.4: Atthi pana te gāmaṇi Uruvelakappe manussā yasaṃ te vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā nuppajjeyyuṃ sokaparideva-dukkha-domanassupāyāsāti || ||
sn42.11:2.5: Atthi me bhante Uruvelakappe manussā yesam me vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā nuppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti || 6
sn42.11:2.6: Ko nu kho gāmani hetu ko paccayo yena te ekaccānam Uruvelakappiyānam manussānaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā garahāyavā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā || ko vā gāmaṇi hetu ko paccayo yena te ekaccānam Uruvelakappiyānam manussānaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya va nuppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā ti || ||
sn42.11:2.7: Yesam me bhante Uruvelakappiyānam manussānam vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā || atthi me tesu chandarāgo || ||
sn42.11:2.8: Yesam pana me bhante Uruvelakappiyānaṃ manussānaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā nuppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā || natthi me tesu chandarāgo ti || || [Atthi me tesu chanda-] Natthi me tesu chandarāgoti
sn42.11:2.9: iminā tvaṃ gāmani dhammena diṭṭhena viditena akālikena pattena pariyogāḷhena atītānāgate nayaṃ nehi ||
sn42.11:2.10: yaṃ kho kiñci atītam addhānaṃ dukkham uppajjamānam uppajjati sabbaṃ taṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ ||
sn42.11:2.12: Yam pi hi kiñci anāgatam addhānam dukkham uppajjamānam uppajjissati || sabbaṃ taṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ ||
sn42.11:2.16: Yam kiñci dukkham uppajjamānaṃ uppajjati sabbaṃ taṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ ||
sn42.11:2.18: Atthi me bhante Ciravasī nāma kumāro bahi-āvasathe paṭivasati ||
sn42.11:2.19: So khvāham bhante kālasseva vuṭṭhāya purisam uyyojemi
sn42.11:2.21: yāva kīvañca bhante so puriso nāgacchati || tassa me hoteva aññathattam
sn42.11:2.22: Mā heva Ciravasissa kumārassa kiñci ābādhayessati || || 8
sn42.11:3.2: Ciravāsissa te kumārassa vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti || ||
sn42.11:3.3: Ciravāsissa me bhante kumārassa vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā jīvitassa pi siyā aññathattam kim pana me nupajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassapāyāsāti || ||
sn42.11:3.4: Iminā pi kho etaṃ gāmaṇi pariyāyena veditabbaṃ ||
sn42.11:3.5: Yam kiñci dukkham uppajjamānam uppajjati sabbantaṃ chandamūḷakaṃ chandanidānaṃ ||
sn42.11:4.2: yadā te Ciravāsissa mātā adiṭṭhā ahosi asutā ahosi || te Civarasissa mātuyā chando vā rāgo vā pemaṃ vā ti || ||
sn42.11:4.4: Dassanaṃ vā te gāmani āgamma savanaṃ vā te gāmaṇi āgamma evaṃ te ahosi
sn42.11:4.5: Ciravāsissa mātuyā chando vā rāgo yā pemaṃ vā ti || ||
sn42.11:5.2: Ciravasissa mātuyā te vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā uppajjeyyuṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā ti || ||
sn42.11:5.3: Ciravāsimātuyā me bhante vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā jīvitassa pi siyā aññathattam kim pane me nuppajjissanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāti || || 11
sn42.11:5.4: Iminā pi kho etam gāmaṇi pariyāyena veditabbaṃ
sn42.11:5.5: yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ uppajjamānam uppajjati sabbantaṃ chandamūlakaṃ chandanidānaṃ ||
